part-start-and-company-onboarding.desc: Create your Client account, set up your first company, and load a ready-made chart of accounts.

part-inside-the-company.desc: Find your way around: the Overview map, the Tracker, inviting your team, and your profile.

part-customers-and-sales.desc: Add customers, send invoices, take payments and prepayments, and issue credits and refunds.

part-consultants-time-and-payroll.desc: Consultants, timesheets, contracts, benefits, and payroll for consulting and staffing firms.

part-vendors-bills-and-the-vendor-portal.desc: Enter vendor bills, pay them by check, bank, or card, and let suppliers submit bills online.

part-banking-cards-and-loans.desc: Bank accounts, deposits, transfers, reconciliation, company credit cards, and loans.

part-inventory-and-company-records.desc: Stock and assemblies, the chart of accounts, journal entries, imports, budgets, and assets.

part-reports.desc: Profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, aging, sales, purchase, and payroll reports.

part-settings-and-a-connected-week.desc: Company preferences, email and branding, data export and import, and a week end to end.

part-pages-and-dialogs.desc: Every pop-up window you meet on timesheets, invoices, bills, the bank, and settings.

part-every-field-on-the-screen.desc: A field-by-field reference for customers, invoices, bills, banking, stock, and reports.
